articles.title: IATP Names QubicaAMF Preferred Partner for Bowling Equipment and Technology
articles.summary: The International Adventure & Trampoline Parks Association has named QubicaAMF its Preferred Partner for bowling equipment and technology under its Profitable Park Program. IATP members will receive preferred pricing on QubicaAMF gear, directly reducing capital investment costs for operators adding bowling to their FEC mix. This partnership signals a growing trend of trampoline parks and hybrid FECs expanding into bowling as an anchor attraction.

articles.title: ESAC Uses Shanghai WUNPARK Case to Outline 2027 FEC Design Trends
articles.summary: Industry design firm ESAC draws on the Shanghai WUNPARK project to illustrate how FECs are shifting from attraction-mix venues to social destinations, a key design philosophy for 2027. The analysis highlights how curating spaces for dwell time, social interaction, and experience variety drives repeat visitation and higher per-cap spend. FEC operators planning new builds or renovations should take note of these evolving layout and programming principles.

articles.title: Querion Hypermedia Entertainment Park Introduces New Indoor FEC Concept
articles.summary: Querion is a fully indoor entertainment park concept that combines immersive rides, interactive experiences, and media-driven environments into a single guided visitor journey under one ticket. The format packages large-scale immersive technologies previously seen in temporary art exhibitions into a compact, permanent FEC destination. For operators and investors, this represents a compelling new model for high-density urban locations seeking differentiation beyond traditional FEC attraction mixes.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment Center has opened a new venue in Denton, expanding the brand's footprint in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro market. The opening adds to a wave of new FEC launches across the region, reflecting continued consumer demand for out-of-home family entertainment. Operators in competitive markets should monitor how Launch's attraction mix and pricing strategy perform in this densely served market.

articles.title: Premiere Cinemas Expanding with Large-Scale Family Entertainment Center at South Plains Mall
articles.summary: Premiere Cinemas is converting or expanding space at South Plains Mall in Lubbock to include a massive family entertainment center, joining a broad industry trend of cinema operators diversifying into FEC attractions. The move highlights how traditional entertainment anchors are repositioning themselves as multi-experience destinations to combat declining moviegoing. FEC suppliers and operators should watch how cinema-to-FEC conversions evolve as a growth channel.

articles.title: Vekoma and Mobaro Advance Ride Maintenance Integration Partnership
articles.summary: Vekoma Rides and Mobaro have moved beyond their initial partnership announcement to deliver their first live integration, bringing ride engineering data directly into the digital maintenance environment used by operations teams. The collaboration aims to eliminate the inefficiency of switching between separate systems, emails, and documents during daily maintenance workflows. For FEC and attraction operators managing complex ride equipment, this kind of manufacturer-integrated digital maintenance tool can meaningfully reduce downtime and safety risk.

articles.title: Playback 96: A 90s-Themed Immersive Entertainment Venue That Doubles Down on Nostalgia
articles.summary: Playback 96 is a fully realized 1990s-themed entertainment venue designed as an immersive world rather than a themed room, blending arcade games, retro décor, nostalgia-driven F&B, and experiential retail into a cohesive social destination. Every design decision from the facade to the staff language guide reinforces the 90s identity, making it a strong case study in brand consistency for experience-led FEC operators. The concept demonstrates how nostalgia-anchored theming can differentiate an FEC in a crowded market and drive strong social media shareability.

articles.title: Thunderzone Family Entertainment Center Opens in Carrollton, Georgia
articles.summary: Thunderzone Family Entertainment has opened a new location in Carrollton, Georgia, adding another entry-level FEC to a growing list of regional openings across the Southeast. New venue openings in secondary markets signal continued investor confidence in the FEC sector outside major metro areas. Operators in similar markets can benchmark Thunderzone's attraction mix and pricing against their own positioning.

articles.title: 'Masha and the Three Bears' Launches First IP-Based Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: The popular children's IP 'Masha and the Three Bears' is opening its first branded family entertainment center, bringing licensed character worlds into a physical venue format. This follows a broader trend of entertainment IP holders using FECs as a channel for brand extension and immersive fan engagement. FEC operators and developers should monitor how IP-driven concepts perform against generic entertainment centers in driving visitation and premium pricing.

articles.title: ReplayOS Delivers Automated On-Ride Video to Guests' Phones Within Seconds
articles.summary: ReplayOS is a new platform that captures on-ride footage and delivers a personalized video link directly to guests' smartphones within seconds of ride completion, with no app download or kiosk visit required. Launched at Botton's Pleasure Beach in the UK, the system integrates on-ride cameras, guest identification, cloud processing, and mobile purchasing into one automated flow. For FEC operators with coasters, go-karts, or other thrill attractions, this type of frictionless media product represents a meaningful incremental revenue stream and social sharing driver.

articles.title: Dynamic Creatures and Hasbro's Sixth Wall Studio Partner to Deploy AI-Powered Interactive Character Robots
articles.summary: Dynamic Creatures and Hasbro's new AI studio Sixth Wall are collaborating to deploy interactive robots that embody Hasbro's licensed characters with real-time conversational AI and expressive physical movement. The robots can greet guests, send them on adventures, and follow up on outcomes, creating personalized character encounters at scale. For FEC operators interested in IP-driven attractions or character meet-and-greet upgrades, this partnership points toward a new generation of affordable, programmable character technology.

articles.title: Former Supermarket in Fort Wayne Converting to Indoor Slide Park
articles.summary: A former Marsh supermarket in Fort Wayne, Indiana is being converted into an indoor slide park attraction, illustrating the continued repurposing of large-format retail and grocery real estate into family entertainment destinations. This type of adaptive reuse is an increasingly viable path for FEC developers in markets with available big-box vacancies and strong family demographics. The project adds to a growing body of evidence that affordable real estate conversion is driving new FEC supply in mid-tier markets.

articles.title: Nostalgia-Driven Bowling Alley Rebirth Finds New Audience
articles.summary: A bowling alley revival project covered by Ozaukee Press highlights how fond memories of the bowling experience are fueling renewed interest in the format among both operators and consumers. The story reflects a broader industry narrative in which bowling is being repositioned as a social and experiential destination rather than a purely competitive sport venue. FEC operators considering adding or refreshing bowling should take note of how emotional connection and nostalgia are becoming key marketing and design drivers.

articles.title: SimEx-Iwerks Extends BBC Earth Partnership, Announces Two New 4D Experiences
articles.summary: SimEx-Iwerks has renewed its long-standing licensing deal with BBC Studios and will release two new 4D Experiences based on the BBC's Mammals series, available to license worldwide from March 2027. The extension gives FEC operators and attractions with theater installations access to fresh, premium natural history content backed by one of the world's most recognized documentary brands. Operators with aging 4D theater content libraries should evaluate these new titles as a cost-effective way to refresh their guest experience.

articles.title: DOF Robotics Unveils Dark Ride: A Trackless 360-Degree Immersive Vehicle Platform
articles.summary: DOF Robotics has developed Dark Ride, a trackless vehicle platform with full 360-degree rotation that seats four to eight guests and uses real-time synchronized motion paired with high-resolution projection mapping and multisensory effects. The system gives designers the freedom to stage narrative moments in any direction, creating a more cinematic and unpredictable guest experience than fixed-track dark rides. For FEC developers and attraction investors evaluating next-generation anchor experiences, this platform offers a scalable, story-flexible alternative to traditional dark ride formats.

articles.title: California's Great America Announces 2027 Farewell Season Before Permanent Closure
articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation has confirmed that California's Great America in Santa Clara will close permanently after a 2027 Farewell Season, ending more than 50 years of operation in the Bay Area. The closure will remove a major family entertainment anchor from one of the country's wealthiest metro markets, potentially creating competitive opportunity for nearby FECs and entertainment venues. Operators, developers, and investors in the Northern California market should assess the demand displacement this closure may generate.

articles.title: California's Great America Confirms 2027 as Final Operating Season
articles.summary: Six Flags has confirmed that California's Great America in Santa Clara will operate its final season in 2027, closing a park that has served the Bay Area since 1976. The announcement signals a significant shift in the regional entertainment landscape and may redirect millions of family entertainment visits toward alternative venues. FEC operators, regional chains, and entertainment investors in Northern California have a rare window to capture displaced demand.

articles.title: Teamplay Station Comprehensive Entertainment Center Opens in Brunei
articles.summary: Teamplay Station, a comprehensive entertainment center targeting players of all ages, has opened in Brunei, expanding the FEC format into Southeast Asian markets. The opening reflects growing international appetite for multi-attraction entertainment destinations beyond traditional amusement arcades. FEC operators and suppliers with international growth ambitions should monitor Southeast Asia as an emerging market for the format.

articles.title: Programming and Planning: The Invisible Force Behind Great Attraction Experiences
articles.summary: A new analysis argues that behind every high-satisfaction theme park or attraction visit is a hidden architecture of programming and scheduling that most guests never notice but consistently feel. When done poorly, programming creates friction; when done well, it disappears entirely and allows the sensory experience to shine. FEC operators can apply these principles to optimize daily scheduling, event layering, and operational flow to measurably improve guest satisfaction scores.

articles.title: Real Madrid's Santiago Bernabéu Transforms Into Year-Round Entertainment Destination
articles.summary: Real Madrid and Moment Factory have converted dormant corridor space across two levels of the Santiago Bernabéu stadium into a permanent, ticketed interactive entertainment attraction using RFID wearables, a custom web app, and multimedia storytelling. The project directly addresses the 'dark stadium' challenge by monetizing more than 300 non-event days per year without disrupting live match operations. The model offers a compelling blueprint for FEC operators and entertainment developers interested in activating underutilized venue space.

articles.title: Wisconsin Pub Adds Indoor Golf Simulators to Drive Winter Revenue
articles.summary: A pub in Beloit, Wisconsin has added indoor golf simulators as a winter entertainment option, joining a fast-growing segment of food-and-beverage venues using simulator technology to extend dwell time and attract new customer segments. The move reflects a broader trend of small-scale operators layering in golf simulation as a low-footprint, high-margin entertainment add-on. FEC operators considering simulator bays should monitor how hospitality venues are deploying the format to inform their own competitive positioning.

articles.title: Snorkel Drift: World's First Towed Snorkeling Ride Blends Attraction Thrills with Underwater Exploration
articles.summary: Snorkel Drift is a patented new attraction format that uses an overhead cable tow system to guide participants through a themed underwater environment on a subaquatic board, creating a sensation of underwater flight accessible to non-swimmers. The concept creates an entirely new attraction category by combining cable tow technology, water park theming, and interactive guest control. For FEC and water park operators seeking differentiated anchor experiences, this format represents a potential category-defining addition.

articles.title: Culturenut Launches Circular Marketplace for Renting and Recycling Attraction Assets
articles.summary: Culturenut is a new digital marketplace that allows museums, cultural institutions, and attractions to rent, upcycle, or recycle exhibitions, interactives, and other assets rather than letting them sit in storage or go to waste. The platform connects organizations with surplus assets to those seeking engaging, cost-effective content, addressing both budget pressures and sustainability goals. FEC operators with aging or seasonal attractions could use this platform to refresh experiences affordably or recoup value from retired assets.

articles.title: ISE 2027 Spark Event Expands as Technology Meets Themed Entertainment
articles.summary: The Spark 2027 event at ISE is moving to a larger venue at Fira Montjuïc in Barcelona on February 3 and 4, reflecting growing overlap between the professional AV and display technology industry and themed entertainment design. The expansion signals increasing demand from attraction and FEC designers for access to cutting-edge projection, display, and experiential technology. Operators and designers sourcing technology for new builds or upgrades should consider this event as a key intelligence-gathering opportunity.

articles.title: Miniso Friends Immersive Retail Concept to Launch in UK, Blending Shopping with Themed IP Experiences
articles.summary: Miniso is bringing its Miniso Friends format to Cardiff's St David's shopping centre in 2027, featuring over 6,600 sq ft of immersive retail with dedicated IP toy zones, blind boxes, and licensed merchandise designed to turn a shopping visit into a destination experience. The format is explicitly designed to extend visit duration by layering entertainment value over retail, a strategy that has direct relevance for FEC operators integrating retail into their venues. The UK launch will be a useful case study for how IP-led experiential retail performs in a Western market.

articles.title: Memoir Creative Appoints Chief Growth Officer and Expands Client Services
articles.summary: Memoir Creative, a fabrication and production firm serving the attractions industry, has promoted Kevin Kreczko to Chief Growth Officer and is expanding its service offerings from its 50,000-square-foot production facility. The hire and expansion signal growing demand for custom fabrication and experiential design services as FEC operators invest in differentiated physical environments. Operators and developers sourcing fabrication partners for new builds or renovations should be aware of Memoir's expanded capabilities.

articles.title: Lighting Design Firm Mood Champions Emotional Storytelling Over Technology in Attraction Environments
articles.summary: West Hollywood-based lighting design company Mood, founded by themed entertainment veterans, argues that emotional connection and narrative storytelling should drive lighting decisions in attractions and hospitality environments rather than technology for its own sake. The firm's portfolio spans themed entertainment destinations where atmospheric lighting has measurably shaped guest memory and dwell behavior. FEC operators investing in facility refreshes or new builds should consider how deliberate lighting strategy can elevate the guest experience without large capital expenditure.
